title: Early bird tickets now available for Dot to Dot’s annual feast of live music
content:
10th December 2016

With last year’s Bristol installment of Dot To Dot Festival incredibly boasting nearly 160 live acts across  20 stages in 15 of the city’s best loved music venues, the annual fiesta of live music is set to return in 2017. As we head into the near year, plans for Dot To Dot ’17 are starting to take shape and a limited number of £12 early bird tickets are now available – this is more than 50% off the price of last year’s tickets so, if you are planning to catch next year’s spring bank holiday spectacular, it would be foolish not snap them up now!

To order tickets, visit the official Dot To Dot Festival site:

For a flavour of what’s in store, read our review of the 2016 festival.
